question: Should OpenClaw change contextPruning.ttl to expire or summarize normal conversation history, or keep it tool-result-only and add any manual prune/reset behavior through a separate authorized session/context contract?
rationale: The remaining gap changes documented retention semantics and may add privileged session mutation APIs, so automation cannot choose the product and security boundary safely.

options.title: Define Typed Session/Context Contract
options.body: Approve a single contract for pruning, compaction, reset, retention, authorization, persistence, recovery, and docs before adding endpoint or CLI adapters.

options.title: Clarify Existing Behavior Only
options.body: Document that contextPruning.ttl is tool-result-only and direct users to /compact, /new, /reset, sessions.reset, and narrower open issues for missing controls.

options.title: Retarget TTL Semantics
options.body: Make contextPruning.ttl affect normal conversation history too, accepting a compatibility-sensitive change to the current pruning contract.

recommendation.title: Define Typed Session/Context Contract
recommendation.body: Approve a single contract for pruning, compaction, reset, retention, authorization, persistence, recovery, and docs before adding endpoint or CLI adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the recent keep-open review, current pruning/docs history, and cache-TTL pruning semantics.
